writer: BackupCreationV1 via src/soma/security/backup/portable.py under CreatePortableBackup orchestration
verifier: BackupCreationV1 self_verify: reopen the complete set from disk, verify detached manifest digest and detached HMAC authenticity using the recovery-secret-derived authentication key, verify payload SHA-256, authenticate/decrypt every payload record, reconstruct isolated SQLCipher database, then call LLD-01 verify_restored_database before publication
temporary_policy: create one same-parent temporary set directory owned by the current command; write all three members only inside it; temporary/verification directories never count as completed backup sets and are removed best-effort on failure
finalization_policy: after detached-manifest/authenticity verification, payload AEAD verification and reconstructed-database verification all succeed, atomically rename the complete temporary set directory to the exact final *.somabackupset destination before recording completed receipt/audit evidence
collision_policy: never overwrite an existing final set directory; a committed COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 replay may reuse the recorded final set only when reopening it proves the recorded manifest SHA-256, payload SHA-256 and authentication tag still verify, otherwise fail closed rather than regenerate or replace

container.canonical_header: UTF-8 finite JSON, sorted keys, no duplicate fields, bounded 8 KiB

detached_manifest.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; sorted keys; no insignificant whitespace; duplicate/unknown fields rejected; bounded 8 KiB
detached_manifest.privacy: contains no customer/domain content, secret, DEK, path outside the set, or decrypted encrypted-manifest content

detached_auth.mechanism: HMAC-SHA-256 over the exact canonical manifest bytes
detached_auth.verification: recompute canonical manifest SHA-256, derive authentication key with independent HKDF info, compare tag in constant time, then verify payload digest before decrypting payload
detached_auth.trust_lifecycle: the one-time recovery secret is the portable trust root; authentication key is derived in memory only and never persisted; no machine-local certificate/private key or source-Windows DPAPI state is required

recovery.secret: 20 cryptographically random bytes encoded as a human-copyable representation with >=128 bits entropy; display exactly once
recovery.persistence: secret and derived keys are never persisted by SOMA

encrypted_records: key record containing source live DEK + data_instance_id
encrypted manifest with schema/migration/app identity and all record digests
verification: require exactly the governed set members before restore/export success
verify detached canonical manifest and HMAC authenticity companion before accepting payload identity
verify payload SHA-256/size/header binding from detached manifest
authenticate public payload header as AAD
LLD-01 full restore verification before set publication/use
prohibitions: no source filesystem path required for recovery
payload hash alone never establishes authenticity
missing/invalid manifest or authenticity companion never degrades to payload-only restore
